pull_request.body:
## Purpose

Preserve the **composition-first post-#149 architecture** so the project does not drift back into building a large project-owned Agent Runtime or broad execution stacks by default.

This remains a **research/documentation-only Draft PR**. It does not modify PR #149, does not change accepted `main`, and does not authorize any production dependency or implementation.

The primary direction is recorded in:

- `project-context/COMPOSITION_FIRST_ARCHITECTURE.md`

The existing Prime roadmap/addendum remain useful candidate-specific research material, but **Prime-first sequencing is no longer the intended starting point after #149**.

## Architecture lock

```text
                         ordinary ChatGPT
                               |
                               v
                         CAP TRUST CORE
              identity / authorization / scope
              logical operation / ExpectedEffect
              ambiguity / reconciliation / provenance
              Verification Kernel / Finish Gate
                               |
       +-----------------------+------------------------+
       |                       |                        |
       v                       v                        v
    Sessions                 Desktop                   IoT
       |                       |                        |
 CCCC / #149               WinApp CLI            Home Assistant
 Prime optional            UFO/UFO²              Matter/MQTT via HA
                           OpenAdapt
                           Vision fallback

Browser remains on the accepted Playwright/project boundary unless fresh evidence justifies change.
```

CAP should remain the trusted composition kernel, not the owner of every runtime/executor implementation.

CAP-owned semantics remain:

- stable logical identity;
- consequence authorization/scope;
- operation/attempt identity;
- ExpectedEffect;
- freshness/provenance;
- `PASS | FAIL | UNKNOWN`;
- ambiguous-outcome reconciliation / no blind retry;
- WorkingState for authoritative cross-capability facts;
- Verification Kernel;
- independent Finish Gate;
- exact source/runtime provenance where required;
- adapter conformance obligations;
- exactly-six public semantic tools unless separately accepted.

Upstream `accepted/success/invoked/sent/completed` is evidence, not CAP `PASS` or whole-task `DONE`.

## Reuse-first rule

After #149, do **not** build broad project-owned versions of the following without a measured conformance gap and fresh Stage Research:

- generic daemon/supervisor;
- generic persistent session/actor registry;
- generic durable messaging/inbox;
- generic delivery ledger for every provider;
- generic persistent conversation manager;
- generic scheduler/heartbeat/goals runtime;
- generic retained-worker/subagent runtime;
- generic Windows UIA/selector/input/screenshot engine;
- per-application CAP adapters by default;
- per-site/per-web-app CAP adapters by default;
- own demonstration recorder/compiler/replay stack;
- own IoT registry/Matter/MQTT/vendor integration stack.

For every proposed mechanism:

```text
needed capability
 -> accepted/researched substrate?
 -> credible mature external component?
 -> narrow adapter possible?
 -> conformance/failure test
 -> measured gap?
      no  -> reuse/adapt
      yes -> smallest custom mechanism for that exact gap
```

## Provider families

Do not collapse all execution into one universal provider state machine.

Prefer narrow families:

```text
SessionProvider
DesktopProvider
BrowserProvider
ProcedureProvider
DeviceProvider
```

Shared CAP invariants sit above them; provider-native state remains native where flattening would lose useful semantics.

The adapter conformance suite is an **acceptance contract first**, not authority to merge all adapters into one runtime.

## Sessions

### PR #149

Finish and freeze #149 as the specialized isolated provider:

```text
fresh / independent / non-personalized / no-plugin / Temporary Chat
```

Do not generalize it into the persistent-session runtime.

### Persistent ordinary ChatGPT

After #149 merge, CCCC (or an equivalent mature substrate found by fresh research) is the **first candidate** for persistent ordinary-ChatGPT target binding, delivery, crash settlement and no-blind-resend mechanics.

CAP should keep canonical `session_ref/model_request_id`; provider delivery IDs/receipts are provider evidence.

Mandatory first authority gate: prove the selected CCCC Web Model profile can be **transport/session-only**, with shell/git/repo-edit/code-execution mutation paths physically unavailable outside CAP rather than merely discouraged by prompt.

If current CCCC cannot do this directly, first evaluate the smallest config/profile/upstream contribution/fork. Do not rebuild the whole persistent-session runtime locally unless that route is proven impractical.

### Prime

Prime is **off the critical path for basic persistent ChatGPT**.

Research/adapt Prime only if a concrete missing primitive remains, such as persistent Python/kernel state, retained compute workers, subagents, compaction or long-running local agent-loop mechanics.

Prime stays behind a narrow adapter and must not inherit CAP consequence authority.

## Desktop / Windows

Installed Windows applications should normally be treated as applications behind the generic `DesktopProvider`, **not** as new CAP capability families requiring one adapter per product.

Default research order after #149:

```text
1. WinApp CLI / UI Automation semantic automation
2. UFO/UFO² or another qualified reusable application-aware Windows layer
3. structured GUI + synthetic input
4. selective vision grounding
```

WinApp CLI is the first candidate for generic Windows mechanics. If a complex application needs richer app-specific mechanics, prefer UFO/UFO² or another reusable application-aware executor before creating a direct CAP-native adapter.

Application-native APIs/COM/object models may be used **inside** a qualified reusable Windows/application executor when that improves mechanics, but they are not the default CAP expansion strategy.

The intended user experience is:

```text
install/open another Windows app
        ↓
CAP DesktopProvider
        ↓
WinApp/UIA first
        ↓ insufficient
UFO/UFO² or equivalent reusable app-aware mechanics
        ↓ insufficient
synthetic input / vision fallback
```

Do **not** default to:

```text
AutoCADProvider
SolidWorksProvider
ExcelProvider
WordProvider
PhotoshopProvider
...
```

A direct app-specific CAP adapter requires a measured gap and fresh Stage Research.

CAP keeps authorization, target/operation identity, ExpectedEffect, fresh post-action observation, reconciliation and Finish Gate. Successful UI invocation alone is never CAP `PASS`.

## Browser / web applications

The same composition rule applies when the application is in the browser.

A new web application should normally be treated as a target behind the generic `BrowserProvider` and the already-accepted Playwright/project Browser path, **not** as a new CAP capability family or a mandatory site-specific integration.

Default route:

```text
new web application / site
        ↓
CAP BrowserProvider
        ↓
existing Playwright/project Browser path
        ↓ insufficient
reusable site-aware browser mechanics
        ↓ insufficient
narrow site-specific Browser adapter
        ↓
selective visual/coordinate fallback where allowed
```

Figma, Google Sheets, Notion, Canva, CRM/ERP systems and similar browser products should first be attempted through the generic Browser path. Do **not** default to `FigmaProvider`, `GoogleSheetsProvider`, `NotionProvider`, `CanvaProvider`, etc.

A direct site-specific Browser adapter is the last step and requires a measured repeatable gap plus the applicable fresh Stage Research. Site-specific mechanics must remain below the existing CAP Browser identity/provenance/authority/ExpectedEffect/verification boundary; a successful Playwright action is evidence, not CAP `PASS`.

## Procedures

OpenAdapt remains the first reuse candidate for demonstration capture / compile / deterministic replay mechanics behind CAP evidence/ExpectedEffect/Verification/Finish boundaries. Do not build a parallel project-owned recorder/compiler by default.

## IoT

Preserve the existing IoT Stage Research decision: production remains deferred until concrete re-entry; Home Assistant remains the preferred first backend candidate; direct Matter/MQTT/vendor stacks are measured-gap-only.

Core invariant:

```text
backend accepted command
        !=
backend observed state change
        !=
required physical effect proven
```

## Required order after #149

```text
#149 accepted + merged
        ↓
refresh this branch from new main
        ↓
rerun repository skill bootstrap
        ↓
Composition Stage Research
        ├─ Sessions: CCCC first candidate
        │    -> transport-only authority gate
        │    -> persistent multi-turn proof
        │    -> crash/ambiguous/wrong-target conformance
        ├─ Desktop: WinApp CLI first candidate
        │    -> generic DesktopProvider proof
        │    -> UFO/UFO² only for measured application-aware gaps
        │    -> 3-4 representative application L3 matrix without per-app CAP adapters
        ├─ Browser: preserve accepted Playwright generic path
        │    -> no per-site CAP adapter by default
        │    -> specialize only after a measured repeatable web-app gap
        ├─ Procedures: revalidate OpenAdapt selected roles
        │    -> bounded demo/compile/replay spike
        └─ IoT: preserve DEFER until a concrete device consumer exists
        ↓
define adapter conformance obligations
        ↓
implement only thin adapters + CAP-owned remainder
        ↓
custom code only for measured gaps
```

Prime Stage Research is no longer mandatory before persistent-session work. Run it only if Composition Stage Research demonstrates a concrete missing runtime primitive Prime may solve.

## Scope lock

Until fresh Stage Research changes this direction, treat the intended post-#149 boundary as:

```text
CAP = trusted composition kernel
      + narrow provider adapters
      + provider conformance / physical acceptance

not

CAP = project-owned implementation of every agent/session/desktop/browser/procedure/IoT runtime
```

No production implementation belongs in this PR yet.

reviews.body:
Post-#149 architecture note / decision reminder:

Do not immediately build a broad CAP-native persistent/existing-session runtime after PR #149. First refresh this Prime branch from accepted main and perform exact-source Prime Stage Research to determine which session-runtime responsibilities should be reused from Prime versus remain CAP-owned.

Key boundary to preserve during that research:

Prime may be allowed to provide session runtime, persistence, supervision/daemon mechanics, attach/detach, retained sessions/workers, and related messaging/runtime mechanics when evidence justifies it.

CAP must retain the trust/transport boundary: opaque exact ChatGPT target/conversation binding, stable delivery/model-request identities, one-shot Send authority, ambiguous-outcome `unknown` state and reconciliation, no blind resend, foreign/wrong-conversation rejection, durable delivery receipt/correlation, source/runtime provenance, authorization, verification and Finish Gate authority.

Only after `ADAPT | KEEP | ADOPT` should a separate Existing-Session Delivery Stage Research define and implement the CAP-owned remainder.

MimiSeek automatic reviewer continuation, Prime MODEL_REQUEST delivery, and later manager wake/resumption must all remain consumers of the same generic capability. Do not introduce MimiSeek-, UV Studio-, GitHub-, repository-, PR-, review-, PASS/FINDINGS-specific routing into CAP.

This note is intentionally metadata-only while #151 remains parked; no production implementation or HEAD change is authorized by it.
